apis.description:
Returns consolidated user context data for Journey, combining account
permissions, career experience info, enrollment types, admin roles,
and site admin status in a single response.

operations.notes:
Returns consolidated user context data for Journey, combining account
permissions, career experience info, enrollment types, admin roles,
and site admin status in a single response.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description:
Canvas account ID for permission and subaccount admin checks. Defaults
to the domain root account ("self"). Other fields (experience,
enrollment_types, admin_roles, is_site_admin) always resolve against
the domain root.

permissions.description: Account permission checks for the authenticated user.

experience.description: Career experience summary including current app and available apps.

enrollment_types.description: Distinct enrollment types for the user (active, invited, and pending).

admin_roles.description: Admin roles on the domain root account.

is_site_admin.description: Whether the user is a site admin.

is_subaccount_admin.description: Whether the user admins a subaccount under the domain root. When account_id is provided, true only if the user can admin that specific account.

is_root_account_admin.description: Whether the user is an admin on the domain root account or a site admin.

is_root_account.description: Whether the resolved account (account_id, or the domain root when omitted) is itself a root account rather than a sub-account.
